title: Double A (1991) Public Company Limited | LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
Double A is one of the most advanced fully integrated pulp and paper manufacturers in the world, internationally recognized as the leading premium quality copy paper provider in 130 countries. Our vision is to support the work performance of Executives around the world, by delivering premium quality copy and office paper, as well as premium quality office stationery products. Created for sophistication and reliability, Double A products deliver excellent performance and enjoyment for its users. All our paper products are made of sustainable fiber from Double A’s ‘Paper Trees’, which are grown along the rice paddy ridges of more than 1.5 million farmers across Thailand - a uniquely Asian solution to the sustainable sourcing of fiber. Launched in 2000, Double A is headquartered in Thailand with offices in 15 countries and teams in over 50 countries, including Australia, Bangladesh, Cambodia, China, Egypt, Hong Kong, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Pakistan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, the United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Our #WorkHardPlaySmart culture places priority on job fulfilment, where having fun in our work is a key ingredient our innovative product and market strategies. Join the Double A team today. Check out our open positions, or contact us for business collaborations.
